mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, stock_code, hold_count, buy_total_cost FROM user_stock_hold WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND hold_count > 0 ORDER BY stock_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_stock_hold (user_id, stock_code, hold_count, buy_total_cost) VALUES (#{userId}, #{stockCode}, #{holdCount}, #{buyTotalCost})
